main_text.p: Iohan.6.68. ⟨Κύριε⟩ πρὸς τίνα ἀπελεύσομεθα, ad quemnam abituri essemus? item quoties τίν῾ vertitur cujus & non alicujus, licet non sit interrogativum reipsa sed tantum potestate, ut Iohan.19.24 λάχωμεν ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ, τίν῾ ἔσται, fortiamur de illa, cujus futura sit. Iohan.2.25 τί ἦν quidnam esset. Iohan.4.10. τίς ἐστιν & quisnam sit, Iohan.6.64. τίνες εἰσὶν quinam essent, Luc.19.15. τίς τί διεπραγματεύσατο, quis quid negotiando confecisset, Iohan.12.49. τί εἴπω καὶ τί λαλήσω quid dicam, & quid loquar.
At τὶς aliquis ἀόριστον indefinitum sic declinatur.

46. Sic πῦρ ignis, in nominativo plurali πυρὰ ignes, incendia, pro πύρα idq; neglecto discrimine. In causa est litera ῥ̄ ad quam accentus festinat. Iliad.θ.509.557. &c. At πυρὰ ὡς ἡ (Ionicè ἡ πυρὴ) pyra, rogus ardens. Iliad.ψ.164.

47. Dicitur etiam λάων, κράτων, δάδων, quae contracta sunt ex λαάων, κρατάων, δαιδῶν. à nominativis λᾶας ἁ ὁ lapis. κρᾶς ἡ τὸ caput. δαΐς δαΐδ ἡ fax à δαίω uro. quamvis non negem λᾶς λᾶος ὁ lapis, δᾶς δαδὸς ἡ fax, κρᾶς

page.notes: The left margin strip belongs to the facing page and contains faint printed notes; they are damaged and mostly illegible, so not transcribed. Accents and Greek forms are copied as far as legible; some Greek words are doubtful and may contain errors. The line "Bb 3" appears as a signature at the foot.
